review_bundle_role: interaction projection derived from AIM; not a semantic source of truth
rules: Semantic information groups and human review bundles are different constructs.
Review bundles must be derived from AIM dependencies, authority, uncertainty, stability and cognitive load.
Already-supported and safely-derived fields should remain silent unless context is needed for a consequential decision.
Analyst-visible candidate is blocked while machine-detectable authoring/runtime defects remain.
